messages:
Maya: Kicking off a config-only rollout for sku-routing + tinybatch tweak. Change window 22:00-00:00 PT. DeployBot will post canary stats. Pinning model v3.2.1-alpha for critical tenants (payments, auth). Please ack.
DeployBot: [automated] Canary rollout started — env=prod shard=east-1 step=canary traffic=5% (will report every 5m). CI: green.
Jason: ack — quick q: what are the timeout/ttl/batch values we’re changing?
Maya: request_timeout_ms 3000 -> 4000, kv_cache_ttl_s 600 -> 1800, batch_size 8 -> 12, tinybatch_window_ms 25 -> 50. Pinning only the 3 tenants listed so others stay on stable.
Priya: noted. batch_size=12 to improve GPU fill / reduce per-token cost. tinybatch window bump to 50ms to avoid tiny batches during spiky traffic.
Maya: config snippet to apply on canary: 
```json
{"routing_policy": "sku-aware", "batch_size": 12, "request_timeout_ms": 4000, "kv_cache_ttl_s": 1800}
```
Luke: monitoring checks I'm adding: alert if error_rate > 2% for 5m, or p50 latency regression > 200ms sustained 3m, or p95 > 1200ms. Will post links to dashboards.
OpsRunner: rollback triggers agreed: error_rate > 2% OR sustained p50 regression >200ms OR increase in OOMs on serving nodes. If triggered I'll execute the rollback playbook and notify here. :rotating_light: 
Jason: make sure canary traffic lives in a dedicated pool so we don't hit reserved tenants. Also confirm canary won't touch the dedicated GPU pool for high-SLA customers.
Maya: confirmed — canary uses dedicated-pool-sku1, not the shared reserved pool. Target tenants: payments, auth, partner-ops.
DeployBot: Canary traffic ramp schedule: 5% -> 20% after 10m -> hold 15m -> report. Metrics: https://dash.reed/canary/1767777777
Priya: watching logs. observed one 500 at t+3m, looks transient (downstream timing). No pattern yet.
Maya: holding at 20% for 15m to collect latency baseline and error rates.
Jason: ACK, I'll be on-call and watching SLOs.
DeployBot: Canary metrics update (t+15m): p50=85ms p95=290ms error_rate=0.14% cpu_util=68% memory=49%. No OOMs.
Luke: metrics look healthy. No regressions on p50 or error rate.
Maya: planning to ramp to 50% at 22:40 and full by ~23:10 if stable. Anyone object?
Priya: no objections. Will keep a 30m heightened log retention to spot quality regressions.
OpsRunner: I'll be ready to kick the rollback if any trigger trips. Sharing rollback checklist now.
Maya: release notes draft for the internal changelog: 
- Config-only: sku-aware routing enforced for pinned tenants
- batch_size increased to 12 (improves GPU efficiency)
- tinybatch window increased to 50ms (reduces lots of micro-batches)
- request timeout raised to 4s to absorb backend variance
- KV cache TTL lengthened to 1800s for better prefix reuse
Pinned model version: v3.2.1-alpha for payments/auth.
DeployBot: ramp to 50% complete. Canary remains healthy.
DeployBot: Full rollout initiated -> final 100% completion in progress.
DeployBot: Full rollout complete at 23:04 UTC-8. Summary: p50=92ms p95=310ms error_rate=0.18% (within thresholds). No OOMs.
Maya: thanks team — nice and quiet. I'll unpin tenants after 2 hours if no regressions. Leaving elevated monitoring for 4h.
Priya: will watch for quality drift or hallucination uptick; will post any prompt/response anomalies.
Jason: updating public release notes and internal ticket. :white_check_mark:
OpsRunner: logging the deployment and closing the incident channel. If anything pops, reopen this thread.
Maya: closing out — great coordination. :tada:
